owner: scripts/pipeline/authored_sign_cards.py (FL-4876 CARD-FIX-01); read by scripts/pipeline/compile_sign_sprites.py beside place_front_logo_sources.v1.json
purpose: One hand-drawn sign card per shop. The Classic view resolves about 0.13 m per screen column and 0.075 m per half row of wall, so a photo crop at that density loses all text (build_reg_87: 0 of 15 shop logos readable). A card keeps the brand board colour and stripes and draws the shop name with a 5x7 pixel font as large as the board allows. A card replaces the crop of the same placement_id / place_feature_id.
font: 5x7 block capitals, digits and the lowercase letters a e i l m p r s t y; no kana or kanji. romanised: true marks every card whose drawn text is a romanisation of kana or kanji.

review.method: each card was transcribed by looking at its source crop (path in text_basis); colours are read off the crop and snapped to the board colour a viewer sees at street distance
